messages:
dana: Heads-up: short SOC2/ISO evidence collection next week (Apr 20-24). We're targeting control owners only. Please submit one lightweight artifact per control: screenshot, short CSV row, or a link to a ticket. Form: https://go.redwood/soc2-mini :spiral_calendar:

omar: Are vendor security reviews included in this sweep?

dana: Only if you're listed as a control owner for vendor management. Otherwise we will reach out separately.

celine: I'm covering product controls for the week. Will upload a CSV with owner + last review date by Tue EOD.

mike: For service accounts, should we include last-used timestamp? I can pull that quickly.

dana: Yes please. Last-used timestamp or last rotation date is perfect.

compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled / DM to listed owners on 2026-04-20T09:00Z.

omar: Uploaded screenshots + links to contract appendix for the two vendors I own. Marked one contract as "sample request" in case audit needs full PDF.

celine: CSV attached. Note: several entries show training >12 months old; marked as stale where applicable.

mike: Pushed SA list with last-used times. Tagged primary owner.

dana: Thanks all 1 managers: confirm by Fri EOD or mark an exception in the form. We aim to finish with minimal follow-ups.

compliance-bot: Auto-follow-up set for 2026-04-23T16:00Z for outstanding items.

omar: thx!

celine: thanks, will check back if anything else needed.
